independenceRationale: The qualifying studies are independent programmes from different institutions and data sources. The 2026 RWTH work measures cavity and screw-antechamber pressure, controller response and part mass for virgin and post-consumer-recycled polypropylene with an open companion dataset; the 2024 UMass Lowell programme independently compares virgin and recycled PP in a multi-cavity hot-runner tool using processing history, crystallization or morphology and physical mechanical outcomes. They do not duplicate or re-analyse one experiment.
promotionClaim: Promote the mechanism-level statement that measured recyclate source, contamination, degradation and prior processing can alter moulding response and physical part-quality even when nominal resin identity appears similar. Do not promote any recycled-content fraction, pressure, temperature, residence time, melt-flow value or mechanical property as a universal acceptance rule or process setting.
